name: Volta CityBus 12 m
class: Battery-electric city bus (simulated with the SUV drive profile) on a CANopen network
interfaces: CANopen 250 kbit/s (CiA 301): TPDOs of the battery, inverter, charger, HVAC and tyre-pressure nodes; heartbeat; emergency messages for faults; SDO reads of the odometer and 12 V supply
notes: A fictional maker. The object dictionary and PDO mapping are written for the test bench; the protocol is the real one (CiA 301).
